source: User's tenth Lab review (Lab v26.2.12, collision v26.2.12) on Chest-center-0004, run 5fda5626e808 (0-454 s, fps 6, Yolo26m-sem-HackEye26.1-48-1280.pt, 736p, depth da2-metric-outdoor-small, chest-center, user 1.78 m), collision run c1 (the default config of v26.2.12, no overrides), reviewed 0-69 s: 34 correct, 13 remove, 2 added. Kept in the repo because version bumps wipe Lab runs/reviews. One window w0 = 0-72 s of the run from its start (cold start). Arrays: grids, DA2 depth (68x120 float16 exactly as the run stored it, see chest0004_review9) and 60 Hz motion incl. resid up to 150 s, the device sensors (keys sensors_*, the GoPro GPMF streams on the recording's time line) up to 156 s. Why motion and sensors run to 150/156 s: the gyro bias is interpolated between the stationary spans of the whole motion track and the heading takes the GPS course; a bare clip finds no span and the clocks shift (same reason as chest0004_review9; the spans / GPS needed lie before 150 s). Replay with speechRate 1.25 (the default of v26.2.12) and the default sound profile.
